# Axial Skyrmions

- The reflection operation changes the sign of only one pion field, resulting in a relative phase definition that differs by an addition of π compared to refs.[3, 12, 7], where the antiSkyrmion is obtained by changing the sign of all three pion fields, and this paper's definition allows for a more natural comparison with the similar situation for monopoles.
- The profile function equals zero at a radius s/2 from the centre of the Skyrmion or antiSkyrmion, enabling the Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion to be patched together continuously with the fields set to the vacuum outside each of the cores (3.10).
- Beyond the simple ansatz (3.7) for initial conditions, more sophisticated initial conditions were employed based on the rational map ansatz [11] with an axially symmetric charge n map.
